title: Capability Token
description: A bearer credential authorizing a specific physical action on a scoped resource with short expiry

action_id.description: Action identifier from the action registry (e.g., 'dispense', 'open_valve', 'set_temperature')

subject.description: Actor identity (user, service, or AI agent) receiving the token

issued_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when token was issued

expires_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when token expires (short TTL, e.g., 5-60 seconds)

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the token payload (Ed25519 or equivalent)

nonce.description: Single-use nonce to prevent replay within TTL

constraints.description: Additional constraints (max volume, temperature range, allowed targets, etc.)

metadata.description: Free-form metadata (experiment ID, run ID, etc.)
